changed.title: What changed
changed.description: Values come from the game files of the builds before and after the patch day; the official notes follow.

impact.title: Around the patch
impact.description: Statistics observed before and after the patch day. They show timing, not cause: player mix, other heroes and other changes move win rates too.

how.gameData: Game data: every value is read from the game files the data source parses per build. The “before” build is the last one before the patch day; the “after” build is the last one of the patch day (or before the next patch).
how.notes: Official notes: shown when the feed carries them (Steam “Minor Update” posts). A before → after appears only when a line states “from X to Y”.
how.stats: Before / after statistics: the 7 days before the patch day (not before the previous patch) vs up to 7 days from it (not past the next patch). “Clear change”: {rule}

how.periods: Each patch’s period runs from its patch day to the next patch, at most 7 days. Statistics compare the older patch’s period with the newer one’s.
how.data: Game-data changes compare the build in effect after the older patch with the build in effect after the newer one, so they include every patch in between.
how.observed: Differences between periods are observed, not explained: the player mix, the rest of the meta and events change too.

filters.gameModeNote: Normal (6v6). The statistics source covers Street Brawl separately; it isn’t shown here.

rules.clear: Both periods have 200+ matches, their 95% intervals don’t overlap, and the win rate moved at least 1 percentage point.
rules.direction: Buff / nerf follows a fixed rule on the property and its values: lower cooldowns, costs, delays and penalties count as buffs; higher damage, health, healing, duration, radius, range, speed, slows and resists count as buffs. Anything else, or a change to or from zero, is shown as “changed”.
